name: router-query
prompt: Add query-string support to the Router in src/router.js. Handlers must receive req.query, an object of the query parameters (a key given more than once becomes an array of its values in order; '+' and %-escapes are decoded). The query string must not affect route matching (today /users/7?tab=x answers 404). Path parameters must be percent-decoded too (/users/ann%20lee gives params.id 'ann lee'), and a malformed escape in the path answers { status: 400 } instead of throwing.
